language: Use the language of the assignment.
tracker: Use the written local task or an issue explicitly assigned by the owner.
start: Start an assigned change when its expected result and scope are clear.
worktree: Use the assigned idle checkout. Preserve other writers and record the review base.
access: Use local synthetic data. Confirm required external services, credentials and access with the project.
tdd: Use for changes with an observable failing test at an established boundary.
verify: Run once locally before opening a PR when an acceptance criterion requires an observed scenario.
verifier: The implementer may verify unless the task requires an independent verifier.
evidence: Record revision, action, expectation, observations, side effects, limits and artifact locations with the task.
acceptance: Report the result and open criteria to the task owner for acceptance.
publication: Obtain specific authority from the owner before pushing, merging, deploying or publishing.
cleanup: Retire only assigned resources after authorized delivery and checking for unpublished work.
ci: No external CI is required for the local baseline.
development_checks: Run the affected checks at the changed boundary.
delivery_checks: Run all required local checks and record results at the delivery revision.
behavior: Exercise the affected public entry point and observe the expected result and material side effects.
